name: @charter/ts
description: charter's TypeScript library, the counterpart of go/: the AsyncAPI generator for oRPC, both specs from one contract, the command behind a spec.ts, and follow(), the gap-free feed. TypeScript sources, imported as they are: Node strips the types, Vite bundles them. A project takes it as a local package ("@charter/ts": "file:../../ts") and brings oRPC and Zod itself (peerDependencies); devDependencies are what the library's own checks use.
